'''''Vaccinium cylindraceum''''', known by its common names such as '''Azores blueberry''', ([[Portuguese language|Portuguese]]: '''uva-da-serra,''' '''uva-do-mato''') is a species of ''[[Vaccinium]]'' endemic to the [[Azores]].

== Description ==
The plant can be propagated by seed or by cuttings.<ref name=":1" /> It forms a shrub reaching up to {{Convert|3|m|abbr=off|frac=2}} in height.<ref name="pfaf.org" /> The [[leaves]] are [[semi-deciduous]], elongated with sharp tips, and serrated. Initially red, the apical shoots may have a bright red colour.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Uva-da-serra|url=http://drrf-sraa.azores.gov.pt/areas/viveiros-florestais/Paginas/Uva_da_serra_especies.aspx|access-date=2026-07-20|website=Secretaria Regional da Agricultura e Florestas|language=es|via=Governo Regional dos Açores}}</ref>

The plant is a [[hermaphrodite]].<ref name="pfaf.org" /> The plant flowers between May and June.<ref name="flora" /> The flowers are trumpet-shaped, with a pinkish white colour, and usually occur in clusters. In autumn the leaves may change to a reddish-yellow. The fruit is a cylindrical black pseudo-berry up to {{Convert|2.5|cm|abbr=off|frac=4}} long; it is fleshy and juicy.<ref name="pfaf.org">{{Cite web|title=Vaccinium cylindraceum|url=https://pfaf.org/user/Plant.aspx?LatinName=Vaccinium+cylindraceum|access-date=2026-07-20|website=PFAF Plant Database}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> The plant has a [[diploid]] set of genes, with a total of 48 [[Chromosome|chromosomes]].<ref name="y832">{{cite journal | last=Redpath | first=Lauren E. | last2=Aryal | first2=Rishi | last3=Lynch | first3=Nathan | last4=Spencer | first4=Jessica A. | last5=Hulse-Kemp | first5=Amanda M. | last6=Ballington | first6=James R. | last7=Green | first7=Jaimie | last8=Bassil | first8=Nahla | last9=Hummer | first9=Kim | last10=Ranney | first10=Thomas | last11=Ashrafi | first11=Hamid | title=Nuclear DNA contents and ploidy levels of North American Vaccinium species and interspecific hybrids | journal=Scientia Horticulturae | publisher=Elsevier BV | volume=297 | year=2022 | issn=0304-4238 | doi=10.1016/j.scienta.2022.110955 | article-number=110955| doi-access=free }}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
This plant is endemic to the Azores, where it can be found on all islands except [[Corvo Island|Corvo]]<ref name=":0"/> and [[Graciosa]].<ref name="flora">{{cite web |title=Vaccinium cylindraceum |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1vaccinium+cylindraceum |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=22 May 2021}}</ref><ref name="858895-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:858895-1 |title=''Vaccinium cylindraceum'' Sm. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=8 October 2020 }}</ref>

This species can be found at elevations between {{Convert|380-1,400|m|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{Cite web|last1=Bgci)|first1=Emily Beech (IUCN SSC Global Tree SG /|last2=Luís Silva (Departamento de Biologia|first2=Universidade dos Açores)|date=2016-10-12|title=IUCN Red List of Threatened Species: Vaccinium cylindraceum|url=https://www.iucnredlist.org/en|access-date=2020-11-04|website=IUCN Red List of Threatened Species}}</ref> It grows best in [[Soil pH|acidic]], loam, well-drained soil and can grow in little to no shade.<ref name="pfaf.org"/><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Vaccinium cylindraceum Azores blueberry Care Plant Varieties & Pruning Advice|url=http://www.shootgardening.co.uk/plant/vaccinium-cylindraceum|access-date=2020-11-04|website=www.shootgardening.co.uk|language=en}}</ref>

==Uses==
The species has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]] as an ornamental.<ref>{{cite web |title=''Vaccinium cylindraceum'' Azores blueberry |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/18672/Vaccinium-cylindraceum/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=8 October 2020 }}</ref>
